workbench.contentAnchor: Look along the top of this screen, over on the right, for a small green word: Saved. You never press a save button here. Every time you answer something or finish a part of a lesson, this website writes it to your own record, and that green word tells you it has landed. Your work follows your login, so you can pick it up on any school computer.

snapshot-q.name: snapshot-q
snapshot-q.textSnippet: A robot is told to take three steps forward, then turn left, then take two more steps forward. What would change if it turned left FIRST and then took all five steps?
snapshot-q.contentAnchor: A robot is told to take three steps forward, then turn left, then take two more steps forward. What would change if it turned left FIRST and then took all five steps?
snapshot-q.cardText: 1 OF 12 · A robot is told to take three steps forward, then turn left, then take two more steps forward. What would change if it turned left FIRST and then took all five steps? · A · It would not move at all · B · It would end up somewhere different · C · It would end up in exactly the same place · D · The robot would break
